root_cause: MakeText bottom is the text baseline, not the bitmap edge. Original pickerBitmap passed image height as baseline so descenders extend beyond the clipped destination bitmap.
reference: Apple Newton Programmers Reference2.0 p10-32 (PDF page691)
fix: Shared baseline=max(FontAscent(ROM),FontAscent(CJK)); retain original fonts and use this baseline instead of bitmap edge. Reserve row margins.
